# webtables/shl

> Shift left: `<<`, the count taken modulo 64, with `i64.shl`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/shl.pkg) · translates [std/shl](../std/shl.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.shl
{left}
{right}
)
```
